page.title: Entering driver activity - TachoMobile 2
page.heading: Entering driver activity
page.intro:
When starting and ending work, TachoMobile 2 displays a form in which you can complete the most important information regarding the shift.

The application can complete most of the data automatically, but you can always check and correct it before saving the entry.

start.title: Getting started
start.intro: After selecting"Get started / Insert driver card"a start-up form will appear.

initialActivity.title: Initial activity
initialActivity.text: Choose an activity to start your day with. The default is thisWork, but you can choose a different activity if your day starts differently.

vehicle.title: Registration number
vehicle.text:
Select the vehicle with which you start work.

After the first use, the registration number will be remembered in the vehicle list, so you will not have to enter it again on subsequent days.

location.title: Country and city of start
location.text:
The country and city are automatically determined based on the current location of the phone.

If the data is incorrect, you can correct it before saving the entry.

odometer.title: Meter status
odometer.text:
Enter the current vehicle odometer reading.

The entered value will then be used as a reference point for subsequent activities and may be automatically completed based on the last saved state.

dateTime.title: Start date and time
dateTime.text:
By default, the current date and time are set.

You can change it if you started working earlier, e.g. a few or a dozen or so minutes before opening the application.

notes.title: Comments
notes.text:
Here you can add additional information about getting started.

The field is optional.

transport.title: ⚙️ Settings regarding how transport is performed
transport.intro: The job start form also includes three options that affect how the entries are interpreted and the appropriate rules are applied.

crew.title: Riding in a crew
crew.text:
Enabling this option means that the entire shift will be interpreted as crew work.

This affects the method of calculating working time, driving time, rest periods and other limits resulting from the regulations regarding crew driving.

international.title: International transport
international.text:
Enabling this option allows you to apply the appropriate international shipping rules.

This is important, among other things, for the interpretation of weekly rest periods and the driver's return to base.

passenger.title: Occasional passenger transport
passenger.text:
The option should be turned on when performing occasional passenger transport, e.g. coach transport.

This allows you to apply appropriate rules regarding driving and rest times for this type of transport.

warning.title: Important
warning.text: These options should correspond to the actual nature of the transport performed. They affect how the compliance module interprets data.

actions.title: ✅ Confirm/Cancel
actions.text:
Confirmsaves the start of work.

Cancelcloses the form without saving changes.

finish.title: Completion of work
finish.intro:
After selecting"Remove Card/End Job"a job completion form will appear.

Its operation is similar to the start form.

vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.text: The registration number will be automatically completed based on the initiated change.

location.title: Country and city
location.text:
Data is automatically completed based on your current location.

You can correct them if necessary.

odometer.title: Meter status
odometer.text: The application uses the last known counter reading. You can check and correct it before saving.

dateTime.title: End date and time
dateTime.text:
By default, the current date and time are set.

You can change it if the actual work was finished earlier or you want to correct the record.

notes.title: Comments
notes.text: Optional field for additional information regarding the completion of the job.

actions.title: ✅ Confirm/Cancel
actions.text:
Confirmends the change and saves the data.

Cancelcloses the form without saving changes.

Once finished, TachoMobile 2 starts working as wellrest accrual. At this point you can determine or checkthe purpose of rest, if you use this feature.

quickChange.title: Quick change of activity
quickChange.intro:
While working, you don't have to open the full form every time.

On the home screen, you can tap your current activity to quickly select the next one.

special.title: Special entries
items: ⛴️ Entering the ferry / Exiting the ferry

quickSave.title: ⚡ Quick save
quickSave.text:
If it is enabledquick save, the selected activity will be saved immediately.

If quick saving is turned off, after selecting an activity, a form will appear in which you can check or complete the details of the entry.
quickSave.fields: The form contains the same basic information:
quickSave.summary:
vehicle → country → city → odometer → date and time → comments

Thanks to this, you can both quickly change your activity and precisely determine the moment and place of its start.

important.title: It's worth knowing
important.text1: TachoMobile 2 tries to automatically complete data that is already known from previous records. But that doesn't mean you can't improve them.
important.text2: If the record does not correspond to reality, check the data and correct it before approval.
